chapters.reason: The paper introduces Mamba-2, a state-space model architecture designed to achieve subquadratic complexity, directly addressing the limitations of standard transformer attention.
The paper proposes a new theoretical framework (SSD) that reinterprets state-space models as a form of structured attention, influencing how models are designed and pretrained.
The work explores the duality between SSMs and attention, providing a foundation for converting or relating transformer-like architectures to more efficient linear recurrent structures.
